data.name: Anandan
data.gender_notes: Anandan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anandan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ananda', meaning 'joy' or 'bliss'. It is a name that evokes feelings of happiness and contentment, and is often given to babies as a symbol of the joy and happiness they are believed to bring into the world. The name Anandan carries the meaning “Joy, Bliss” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anandan usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, bliss and live with faith, good character and purpose.
